decisions.topic: Frontend framework for the local web app
options: Flask + simple HTML pages (no build step)
decisions.WHY: Tiny, no build step, runs on any OS with one command, easiest for friends to run offline. User explicitly wanted very lightweight (legacy Q1).

decisions.topic: How existing XLSM data migrates into SQLite
decisions.choice: One-time Python import script; XLSM kept as read-only backup
decisions.WHY: Full rebuild agreed: data + Dashboard + status logic all leave Excel; XLSM retired as working tool (legacy Q3).

options: Row-per-payment ledger (bond, month, amount, paid) with UI-rendered month grid
One column per month (Excel-style) in SQLite
decisions.choice: Row-per-payment ledger; totals/status become live queries
decisions.WHY: Fixes hardcoded headers (Sep-2025..Feb-2027), Jan-2031 scan limit, and stale dashboard. Scales as portfolio grows.

decisions.topic: CSV/Excel export once Excel is no longer the front end
decisions.WHY: Legacy Q4 agreement; covers the spreadsheet/CSV consumer actor.

decisions.topic: Status engine rules in the rebuild
decisions.choice: Fixed rules: Danger = ANY unpaid past month (not just previous month); Completed overrides Danger when months paid >= tenure; zero-value = unpaid preserved
decisions.WHY: VBA quirk: single-month Danger check hides older misses. Owner-visible correctness win, already agreed in legacy decision summary.

decisions.topic: Document format and storage for all project documentation
options: born-JSON docs in .IDE_Plans/docs projected into the SQLite store
decisions.choice: born-JSON + database-driven store for every sequence document (PRD, SRS+RTM, plans, designs, reports); legacy markdown migrated per the D12 eight-step procedure, verified, frozen, then deleted (user-authorized set: the 7 legacy .md docs)
decisions.WHY: User directives Q1 + Q4: no old document format; everything migrated and maintained in the database up to the Design Stage; old files removed after verified migration.

decisions.choice: Strict 12-stage machine; execute stages 1-10 (Div 1 requirements, Div 2 architecture+decomposition, Div 3 dev order + final design); stop before Div 4 execute+CI
decisions.WHY: User directive Q2 + explicit choice 'Through Div 3 final design': at least one complete, highly detailed, implementation-ready design must exist when we stop.

options: PM + 2 Workers, flat topology, all MiMo-V2.6-Flash on Kimi CLI via cline-pass
decisions.choice: PM (Kimi CLI session, coordinator) + up to 2 Workers per wave (same CLI, same model, same access method); flat PM-to-worker topology; fleet size determined by stage needs (docs-heavy stages run 2 workers, code spikes may run 1)
decisions.WHY: User directive Q3: all Captains and Workers use Model MiMo-V2.6-Flash, CLI Kimi CLI, Access Method cline-pass, configured locally. Flat topology because single CLI family; PM coordinates directly (no separate captain hop needed).

decisions.topic: Store layout initialization for this project
options: D120 init: db-store worktree + store symlink on branch dev
Ad-hoc DB file in repo root
decisions.choice: D120 init: db-store branch/worktree (folder = branch) + store -> db-store/store symlink; project name 01_excel_dashboard per D50 (repo folder basename); DB file 01_excel_dashboard_store.db
decisions.WHY: Required by the store layer for projection, gates, and stage machine; repo basename rule D50 fixes the DB name. Base branch for the initiative is the current dev branch (no remote exists, so no push).
decisions.source: PM derivation from store-layer rules; flagged in master plan for user visibility

decisions.topic: Product scope constraints carried into all stages
options: Offline-only, per-user local data, no cloud/accounts
decisions.choice: Offline-only: each user runs the app locally with their own SQLite file; shareable by copying the folder; no accounts, no network mode
decisions.WHY: Legacy interview answers 2 + PRD out-of-scope list; unchanged constraint.

decisions.topic: SQLite MCP server for detailed store inspection
options: Deferred MCP entry for this project's store DB in ~/.kimi-code/mcp.json (uvx mcp-alchemy pattern)
MCP entry + separate web viewer page
decisions.choice: Add a deferred MCP server entry (name: sqlite-excel-dashboard) in ~/.kimi-code/mcp.json using uvx mcp-alchemy with DB_URL pointing at db-store/store/01_excel_dashboard_store.db (project store per D9/D50). Deferred so it activates only when needed; agents gain SQL detail-check tools against the store.
decisions.WHY: User directive Q1 (2026-10-30): wants MCP-based detailed checks of the database content (beyond the 2-item surface view). Follows the proven sqlite-jsonviewer pattern. Note: ~/.kimi-code/mcp.json is OUTSIDE the project root — the edit is explicitly user-authorized by Q1 and touches only the mcpServers block (no keys read or re-written beyond the new entry).

decisions.topic: kimi CLI + pi CLI readiness check for this local project
options: Live smoke test in both CLIs
decisions.choice: Readiness check only: verify both CLIs see this project correctly (AGENTS.md rules loading, skills present, store tools on PATH, venv, MCP entry valid) and report — no config changes from the check itself
decisions.WHY: User directive Q2 (2026-10-30) with explicit choice 'Readiness check only'. pi CLI 1.4.0 confirmed installed; kimi CLI is this session's CLI.

decisions.topic: Approval gating mode for the initiative
options: Full-auto: single standing approval covering all gates
decisions.choice: FULL-AUTO: the user's standing approval covers brainstorm/master/stage-plan gates, worker questions, scope confirms, commits, merges into the base branch, and the user-authorized 7-file legacy deletion. PM still reports every gate result (Rule 5 report-everything); destructive actions outside the authorized set still escalate.
decisions.WHY: User statement 2026-10-30: 'I have already given the task and you can act as the PM coordinator. no need to ask approval.' Matches the lifecycle's full-auto mode definition.
